newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle market up $1-$2 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle market up $1-$2 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were $1.00 to $2.00 per cwt higher, most advance on calves under 600 lbs, compared to last week's close, USDA said.
Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 68.50- 75.00; 700-800 lbs few 64.00-65.50. Holsteins - Large 2 500-600 lbs 50.00-57.00, individual 60.00.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 60.00-66.50; 700- 800 lbs 58.50-62.50. Cattle and Calves Receipts - 2,500.
